mentions.name: Flip Dot Module Clocks
mentions.description: This hardware project revives old 5x7 flip dot display modules of the kind larger displays are made from, building custom driver electronics with measurements and AI-assisted circuit design, a breadboard prototype, and custom PCBs in fabrication. The goal is to restore around 30 modules and build clocks from them to give to family and friends.
mentions.problem: Existing flip dot display projects on the internet were hard to follow for an electronics beginner.
mentions.audience: Existing flip dot display projects on the internet were hard to follow for an electronics beginner.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on getting some old flip dot displays up and running again, more precise the single 5 x 7 modules that bigger displays are made of.
